glosses: since then, now (contrasting between the current state and a known past state)
in the meantime (at the same time as another process, typically in another location)
in the meantime (specifically until the other process is finished)

examples.text: Du kennst inzwischen alle meine Witze.
examples.en: You know all my jokes by now.

examples.text: Inzwischen sollte er damit fertig sein.
examples.en: He should have finished it by now.

examples.text: Inzwischen habe ich mich daran gewöhnt.
examples.en: I'm used to it by now.

examples.text: Inzwischen hast du es bestimmt schon gehört.
examples.en: I imagine you've heard by now.

examples.text: Ich dachte, du hättest inzwischen vielleicht Hunger.
examples.en: I figured you might be hungry by now.
